I. CLASSIC INFORMATION AND STANDARD TRANSLATIONS

• Sanskrit name: Uṣṇīṣa Vijaya Dhāraṇī Sūtra (or Sarvadurgatipariśodhana Uṣṇīṣa Vijaya Dhāraṇī).

• Position in the Tripitaka: Belongs to the Tantric Pitaka (Taishō Tripiṭaka)

• Translation by Buddha-Baly (Buddhapālita) of the Tang Dynasty: Taishō Vol. 19, No. 967 (Buddha's Birth Da La Ni Sutra).

• Translation by Diva Ba Ha La (Divākara) of the Tang Dynasty: Taishō Vol. 19, No. 970 (The Ultimate Buddha Dharma Peak Purifying Karma Sutra).

• Translation by Du Hanh Khai of the Tang Dynasty: Taishō No. 968.

• Translation by Nghia Tinh of the Tang Dynasty: Taishō No. 969.

• Translation of Fearless Zen (Śubhakarasiṁha) of the Tang Dynasty: Taishō No. 974.

• Reputable Vietnamese translators:

Layman Nguyen Thuan: The translator translated the entire text comparing Chinese and Sanskrit characters.

tom_tat: Part II. THE BEGINNING OF THE HISTORY OF TRANSLATION
noi_dung:
II. THE BEGINNING OF TRANSLATION HISTORY

(The story of Tripitaka Dharma Master Buddha Ba Loi went to Ngu Dai Mountain to meet Bodhisattva Manjushri)

In the Nghi Phung era, the first year (676 AD) of the reign of King Cao Tong, in Ke Tan country (Kashmir, in Northern India), there was a Tripitaka monk named Buddha Ba Ly (Buddhapālita, translated as Enlightenment Ho). He is a monk with pure moral precepts. From an early age he made a deep aspiration and sacrificed himself for the sake of Buddhism.

Hearing that China has a delicate mountain range called Thanh Luong Son (Wu Dai mountain, in Son Tay province) is a holy place that displays the teachings of the Great Wisdom Manjushri Bodhisattva, Buddha Ba Ly made a vow to overcome countless miles of remote and dangerous terrain, across the vast desert and sea of sand, determined to go to the East to worship the saint.

After many years of arduous and dangerous diving, it was not until the reign of Nghi Phung that he reached the foot of Ngu Dai mountain. When he looked up at the sacred mountain range, he was deeply grateful, his five limbs were planted close to the ground in sincere prostration, he looked up into the air and shed tears and said:

“From the day the Tathagata entered nirvana until now, all the saints and sages have hidden their shadows, only the compassionate Great Saint Manjushri remained in this young world to guide sentient beings. Buddha Ba Ly's disciples came from the remote place Tay Truc thousands of miles away, not minding hardships and hardships, wholeheartedly devoted, only hoping to see the golden energy of Great Bo. Slap!”

Just after making his vow, suddenly from the canyon, an old man with white hair and beard stepped out. The old man spoke in Sanskrit to Buddha Ba Ly:

“Hey Dharma Master! You did not hesitate to work hard, traveled thousands of miles to come here, wholeheartedly bowed down to meet Lord Manjushri, what an extraordinary wish! However, the sentient beings in this Chinese land have created heavy karma, and even those who have become monks have violated the majestic precepts. There is only theBuddhist Sutra of the Birth of the Sun. Da La Ni is the great secret method of the Buddhas, has the ultimate ability to eliminate all serious evil karma, save sentient beings from the three evil realms of hell, hungry ghosts, and animals. Is it true that on this trip, did the Dharma Master bring that Sanskrit scripture here?"

Buddha Ba Ly said:

“Venerable Elder! This poor man from a faraway land came here purely for a single thought of earnestly admiring the face of Manjushri, so he did not bring that copy of the Sanskrit Sutra.”

The old man said with a serious face:

“ If a magician does not carry that sutra, even if he meets Manjushri Bodhisattva here, he will not receive much of the true benefit! Sentient beings are immersed in the ocean of suffering and evil paths, if they do not have this great mantra, what can they use to save them? The magician should quickly return to Tay Truc, please let him get the Sanskrit sutra Buddha's Birth. THANH DALA NI brought it to China to translate and spread it widely. That is an act of great compassion to save all living beings, to repay the kindness of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, and then the Dharma Master decided to meet Manjushri Bodhisattva!”

After speaking, the old man suddenly disappeared without a trace, in the sky there were only five-colored auspicious clouds surrounding him. Buddha Ba Ly then woke up and knew clearly that the old man was the reincarnation of the Great Saint Manjushri showing signs to him. Both happy and sad, he knelt down on the ground and sincerely prayed, then, regardless of his old age and weakness, immediately turned around and returned to Tay Truc.

After many years of traveling thousands of dangerous miles, he was able to obtain the Sanskrit version of the Buddha's Birth of Da La Ni and bring it back to the capital Chang'an in the second year of Vinh Thuan (683).

When he entered the court of King Cao Tong, the king was very happy, immediately ordered the court translators (including Mr. Do Hanh Khai) to accompany him in translating the sutra into Chinese characters and keeping the sutra in his inner palace, rewarding him with 30 silk sheets. Buddha Ba Ly shed tears and said: “You, the poor man, did not care about your life and went through countless waves and waves to invite scriptures to come here because you wanted to save sentient beings in the world, not because of royal benefits!”

Thankful for that great compassion, the court returned the Sanskrit scripture to him. After that, Buddha Da Ba Ly and monk Thuan Trinh at Tay Minh pagoda translated it into a standard translation that was popularized in the world. After translating the sutra, Buddha Ba Ly brought the original Sanskrit text back to Wutai Mountain, entered the Diamond Cave of Thanh Luong Mountain, then passed away, leaving a lasting name in the history of Buddhist translation.

III. CLASSIC PREFACE

(Excerpt from the Preface translated by Venerable Thich Thien Tam)

The Buddha's Vesak Da La Ni Sutra - one of those methods - is the wisdom seal of all Tathagata; The mystery is wide and deep, unlike boats in the ocean, sun and moon in the gloomy sky. All four groups of people should focus on reciting the chant. All of their sins will be destroyed in this life, blessings and wisdom will arise, and in the future they will be close to the Buddhas in the Pure Land of the ten directions.

Once upon a time, the Heavenly Son Thien Tru in the Dao Loi heaven was about to run out of blessings. He heard a voice warning that in seven days he would die and fall into seven lives as a filthy animal, then fall into hell and endure countless sufferings. Thanks to the Heavenly Emperor Shakyamuni asking for help from Śākyamuni Buddha, the World-Honored One proclaimed this Da-la-ni. Thien Tru Thien Tu followed the teachings for only seven days and nights to eliminate all negative karma, increase his lifespan immeasurably, and attain the path of no birth.

The power of this mantra is immense: hearing it once immediately plants the seed of Bodhi; The wind blows the dust and dirt on the Ton Thang Sutra pillar onto someone else's body, or the shadow of Ton Thang Tower covers someone, that person will eliminate all extremely serious sins and escape the three evil paths.

tom_tat: Part IV. FULL TEXT OF THE BIBLE TRANSLATED — VIETNAMESE TRANSLATED VERSION (1)
noi_dung:
IV. COMPLETE SUTRA TEXT — VIETNAMESE TRANSLATION (1)

SUTRA SUTRA OF SUCCESSFUL BUDDHA PEAK DARANI PURIFYING karma

Chinese translation: Tang Dynasty, Tipiṭaka Samana Earth Ba Ha La (Divākara)

Vietnamese translation: Venerable Thich Quang Tri

This is what I heard:

At one time, Venerable Bat Gia Pham lived at That La Phiet, Truc Quan ashram, Ky Da forest, Anathapindika garden, with a full assembly of eight thousand monks. You are all noble Sravakas, Great Arhats that everyone knows. Those are: Venerable Sariputra, Maha Maudgalyayana, Maha Kassapa, Ani Luat Da, such Great Arhats are the Supreme Leaders.

There are also countless Bodhisattvas and Mahasattvas, all of whom are Irreversible beings with enough immeasurable merit to adorn them. These are: Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara), Miraculous Bodhisattva, Mahasattva Bodhisattva, Compassionate Bodhisattva, Thang Long Lotus Store Bodhisattva, Purification Bodhisattva All Obstacles, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva who is the Chief among the thirty-two thousand Mahasattva Bodhisattvas, along with the great assembly sitting in the assembly.

There were also twelve thousand Devas, Indra as the Chief, along with immeasurable Devas, Dragons, Yaksha, Gandharvas, Asuras, Maholacdas, Khanna-la, Ca-lau-la, Cu-ban-tra, Siddha, Nhon, Phi-nhon together with the assembly sitting in association.

Suddenly in the night, in the void, there was a cry:

“Son of Thien Tru Thien! Your life has only seven more days left. After your death, you will be reborn in the Jambudvipa world, seven times in a row as an animal: eating and swallowing impure things, often suffering from sufferings. After that, you will be born in a human body, be born in a poor, lowly, blind house, unable to see light in your womb, born in a dark place, in a dark place. Growing up, suffering all kinds of suffering, falling into hell and suffering all kinds of suffering, going through thousands of eons without ever coming out!”

“I pray to God to save me from the sufferings of evil paths!”

At that time, the Heavenly Emperor, in the moment of concentration and attentive observation, immediately saw Thien Tru Thien Tru in the future, after his death, seven times in the body of animals: pig, dog, monkey, weasel, snake, vulture, crow; often eat impure foods and suffer immeasurable suffering.

“Only the Tathagata, Perfectly Enlightened One, can save Thien Tru from that suffering!”

At that time, the Heavenly Emperor immediately told Thien Tru:

“You should join me in bringing offerings to Tathagata's place, sincerely praying to Buddha for mercy and rescue.”

At that time, the Heavenly Emperor, Thien Tru, the Heavenly Son, along with the gods, brought flowers, fragrant flowers, celestial robes, precious flowers, and wonderful ornaments to the Buddha. Arriving there, he bowed at the Buddha's feet, circumambulated hundreds of thousands of times, wholeheartedly bowed, presented offerings to the Buddha, then the Heavenly Emperor clasped his hands and respectfully told the Buddha about the matter of the Thien Tru Thien Son receiving evil retribution:

At that time, the World-Honored One emitted a great light from his head, illuminating the entire world in all ten directions. That halo revolved around the Buddha three times and then returned to the Buddha's mouth.

Buddha smiled and told the Heavenly Emperor:

The Heavenly Emperor, there is a dharani named Tremendous Buddha, PURE PEAK OF BEASTS DALANI, who can eliminate all karma, destroy all evil paths: hell, animals, hungry ghosts, the land of Hell, or eliminate all the sins of sentient beings, all of them. causes liberation; or cause sentient beings to have a long life, have a pure body, be born in the pure and peaceful Buddha lands, and forever be free from the evil path."

The Heavenly Emperor heard what Buddha said, was extremely happy, and told Buddha:

“Dear World-Honored One! Please Buddha, for us and all sentient beings in the future, recite that mantra of the Buddha's Birth, causing us and all sentient beings to be liberated!”

(The Sino-Vietnamese and Sanskrit version of the Buddha's Mantra of the Buddha's Name is fully compared in Section VI).

Buddha told the Heavenly Emperor:

“This Pure Beast Da La Ni can eliminate all karma, or eliminate the three evil paths. This Da La Ni is the eighty-eight cu branches that countless Buddhas speak in unison, preserve, support, praise, all Tathagata are able to seal; or eliminate all the sins of sentient beings; or save hell, animals, hungry ghosts, King of Hell. origin.

If living beings with thin blessings, short lives, diseases, lowly, evil, blind, deaf and mute, falling into hell, hungry ghosts, animals, suffering all kinds of suffering, hear this dharani, their evil retributions will be destroyed, they will all be liberated.

If there are sentient beings who have long created evil karma: the ten evils, the five evils, all kinds of evil offenses, whether heavy or light, all are eliminated, they will attain Anuttara Sammyak Sambodhi, forever be far away from the sufferings of animals, the land of Jamma, even the Asuras, Yakshas, Lakshas, Bo-den-na, Katra-bo-den-na, A-ba-sa-ma-ha, all such evil beasts are liberated.”

Buddha told the Heavenly Emperor:

“If there are people who accept and maintain this mantra, from now on they will no longer be reborn in evil realms, will be close to Buddhas, live with Bodhisattvas, or be born into noble lineages of Pham Chi, aristocrats, or in the ashrams of Buddhas until they attain Supreme Bodhi, attain the body of Tathagata, Perfect Enlightenment and liberation.”

Buddha told the Heavenly Emperor and the Heavenly Son Thien Tru:

“This Purity of the Beasts of mine, the Supreme Da La Ni, is majestic and vast, with all the merits and powers, like the auspicious sun-mani jewel, pure and free of dust, illuminating the empty world, like the seven supreme treasures in life. All sentient beings from the ranks of Kings, Princes, Royal Mothers, and hundreds of Prime Ministers all desire it, like to see it without getting bored. bored, because it is miraculously not dirty or dirty.

God! This Da-lani is also like that. If someone accepts, recites, writes, makes offerings, preserves, and teaches for others, that person will also be loved and respected by gods and people.

God! If someone once hears of this dharani, after hundreds of eons and thousands of lives in hell, hungry ghosts, animals, the land of Yama, all sins and obstacles will be destroyed, will not receive evil retribution, will immediately be reborn in the pure Buddha lands of the ten directions, or be born in noble lineages in the human world, no longer falling into evil paths."

Buddha said again:

“God of Heaven! If someone takes clean soil, mixes it with fragrance, builds it into a tower, or at a crossroads, or at the top of a mountain, or in a cave, copies this mantra and puts it in the tower. If there is a Bhikkhu, Bhiksuni, Upasaka, Upasakī or anyone who passes by the shadow of the tower, or the shadow of the tower covers the person's body Then, or the wind blows the dust on the tower and sticks to the body, that person will have to fall into hell, hungry ghosts, animals, all evil beasts, and will no longer receive evil retributions, and will immediately receive the Bodhisattva prediction from the Buddhas!

If someone writes down this mantra and puts it on a tall banner, set up on a mountain top, or on a high roof, with the wind blowing the flag, whoever sees that flag, or the shadow of the flag covers the body, or the wind from the flag blows and sticks to the body, all of that person's sins and hindrances will be cleared!

If there is a person who upholds this mantra, takes a bath, wears clean new clothes, on the full moon day receives the Eight Precepts, recites this mantra a thousand and eight times in front of the Buddha image, that person's life span will be increased, illness will be eliminated, and all obstacles will be eliminated.

If there is a person who falls into the evil realm because of a dead relative or heavy sin, take clean sand and recite this mantra twenty-one times, then sprinkle that sand on the remains or grave of the dead person. That dead person will immediately leave the evil path and be born in the peaceful heavens!”

When the Buddha finished preaching this sutra, Thien De Thich and Thien Tru Thien Tu bowed their heads, paid homage, and returned to the heavenly palace. Thien Tru Thien followed Buddha's teachings and faithfully recited the mantra for seven days and nights.

“This sutra is called Honoring the Buddha, Da La Ni Purification of karma and beasts, mantra sutra. You and the four assemblies of disciples should worship it!”

At that time, the four assemblies of disciples, the great Bodhisattvas, along with the Devas, Dragons, Prajnaparamita, Yaksha, Gandharvas, Asuras, Ca-lau-la, Khan-na-la, Maha-la-ma, humans and non-humans, heard the Buddha's teachings, all felt great joy, received faith, worshiped, and thanked the Buddha. then retreat.

V. COMPLETE SUTRA TEXT — VIETNAMESE TRANSLATION (2)

Dark Sutra of Victory over Buddha, Purification of Karma and Mantra of the Mantra

Chinese translation: Tang Dynasty, Tipiṭaka Samana Earth Ba Ha La (Divākara)

Vietnamese translation: Layperson Nguyen Thuan

This is what I heard:

All of them are great Ying Chans that everyone knows. Their names are: Venerable Sariputra, Venerable Maha Maudgalyayana, Venerable Maha Light, Venerable Indestructible, and other such great Sravakas as their leaders.

There are also countless great Bodhisattvas. All of them are irreversible and have immeasurable merits that can be used to adorn them. Their names are: Guan Yin Bodhisattva (Avalokiteśvara), Miraculous Auspicious Bodhisattva, Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, Tu Thi Bodhisattva, Thang Long Hoa Bodhisattva, Purifying All Obstacles Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, and other such great Bodhisattvas; are the leaders of the 32,000 Bodhisattvas who came to attend the Dharma conference.

Again, there were 12,000 heavenly sons, with the God-lord Indra as their leader, along with countless gods, dragons, yakshas, incense-gear gods, flying stars, golden birds, yin-gods, great pythons, water-transformed ghosts, star-sucking ghosts, humans and non-humans, coming together to attend the Dharma Assembly.

At midnight, a sound suddenly rang out in the void saying:

“Thien Tru Thien Tu! Seven days later, his life will end. From this heavenly world, at the end of his life, he will be reborn in the world of Kham Nhan, seven times in a row as an animal, always eating impure food. Next, he will fall into hell and suffer all kinds of suffering. After many lifetimes, he will be born as a human, but he will be born into a poor and indigent family. In his mother's womb, his eyes will be damaged. blind, born in darkness and raised in darkness, receiving all bitter things!”

At that time, when Thien Tru Thien Tu heard that sound, his whole body trembled, his hair stood up, he was terrified. He was extremely sad and went to Thich De Thich's place, bowed his head close to the feet of the heavenly lord, choked with tears and told the story in full:

“Please God, please save me, please save me from the evil paths of suffering!”

At that time, Divine Master De Thich heard Thien Tru's words and thought in surprise:

The Heavenly Emperor immediately entered concentration, using pure heavenly eyes to observe the paths of reincarnation, clearly seeing Thien Tru's retribution after his death in seven consecutive lives as: pig, dog, monkey, weasel, snake, vulture, crow; eating rotten and dirty food, falling into hell for countless lives and suffering countless punishments.

Seeing that horrifying scene, the Heavenly Deity felt extremely sad and sympathetic, and thought:

The Emperor immediately told Thien Tru:

The two of them and their entourage of gods brought countless solemn gifts to the garden of Anathapindika in That La Piety. After paying homage to the Buddha's feet, circumambulating thousands of times, and offering various offerings, Thich Thich knelt down, clasped his hands, and said to the Buddha:

At that time, from the hump above the World-Honored One's head, a brilliant ray of light was emitted, illuminating all the Buddha lands in the ten directions. The light revolved around the Buddha three times then retracted and entered the Buddha's mouth.

Buddha smiled and said to the Heavenly Emperor:

“How good! How good! Heavenly Emperor, there is a dharma called Supreme Buddha's Birth Purifying Karma Dā La Ni, which is the secret mind seal of all Tathagata. This mantra has the ability to purify all evil realms: hell, animals, hungry ghosts, Hell-ma realm. precepts; purifies all heavy karma, prolongs life, makes the person who recites it pure and perfect, never regressing to the evil path."

Thien De Thich was extremely happy and earnestly requested:

“We respectfully ask the World-Honored One to compassionately proclaim that wonderful mantra!”

(The IAST Sino-Vietnamese and Sanskrit mantra text is presented in detail in Section VI).

Buddha told Heavenly Emperor:

“This Buddha-Than-Signing Mantra was proclaimed by eighty-eight billions of sands of the Ganges River in unison, together with the Buddhas who protected and chanted. This mantra has the power to destroy hell and save sentient beings suffering from suffering. Suppose there is a person who has sinned against the heavens, committing the five transgressions(killing father, killing mother, killing Arhat, causing the Buddha's body to bleed, disrupting harmony). monk), the ten unwholesome evils, once you hear the name of this mantra or recite it, all your sins will disappear like snow melting under the sun.

If someone recites this mantra twenty-one times a day, all karma will be eliminated, longevity will be prolonged, and after death, they will be reborn in the Pure Land of Amitābha Buddha or the pure Buddha lands of the ten directions.

If someone writes this mantra and places it on a banner, on a high roof, on a mountain top, or placed in a stupa; Any living being, whether human or animal, passes by the shadow of a tower, the shadow of a flag covering its body, or the wind blows dust particles from a sutra pillar onto it, all of its sins for thousands of generations will be completely destroyed, will never fall into the three evil realms, will be reborn in a noble place in the next life, and will be prophesied by the Buddhas of Bodhi!”

After seven days, Thien Tru happily saw his evil karma eliminated and his lifespan increased immeasurably. He and the gods brought countless celestial flowers to thank the Buddha. The World-Honored One rubbed his head and gave the Bodhi prediction to Thien Tru Thien Son. The entire assembly in the Dharma Assembly was delighted and accepted the service.

>Immediately say the mantra / Like this:

Abhiṣiñcatu māṁ sugata vara vacana amṛtābhiṣeke mahāmantra-pade:

I pray that the Venerable Tathagata sprinkles the stream of nectar with the wonderful teachings of the great mantra to empower me!

Āhara āhara āyuḥ sandhāraṇi:

Śodhaya śodhaya gagana viśuddhe:

Cleanse, purify all impurities like pure endless space!

Uṣṇīṣa vijaya viśuddhe:

The supremely pure place of Buddha Peak Ton Thang!

Sahasra-raśmi saṁcodite:

Encouraged and illuminated by thousands of brilliant rays of light!

Sarva tathāgatāvalokana ṣaṭ-pāramitā paripūraṇi:

To be contemplated and protected by all Tathagata, fully fulfilling the six Paramitas!

Sarva tathāgata hṛdayādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhita mahāmudre:

The secret Great Seal is solidly blessed from the diamond hearts of all Tathagata!

Vajra-kāya saṁharaṇa viśuddhe:

The indestructible diamond body is captured completely pure!

Sarvāvaraṇāpāya-durgati pari-viśuddhe:

Ultimately purify all obstacles and all dangerous evil paths of the three evil paths!

Pratinivartayāyuḥ śuddhe:

Transforming adversity prolongs a long and pure life!

Samayādhiṣṭhite maṇi maṇi mahāmaṇi:

Remain firmly in your original blessings, O great wish-fulfilling gem!

Tathātā-bhūta-koṭi pariśuddhe:

Ultimate purity in the ultimate nature of True Suchness!

Visphuṭa buddhi śuddhe:

Enlightenment blooms brightly, completely pure!

Jaya jaya, vijaya vijaya, smara smara:

Victory victory! Sun wins, dark wins! Always remember to think, always remember your vow!

Sarva buddhādhiṣṭhita śuddhe:

Pure thanks to the steadfast blessings of all the Buddhas of the ten directions!

Vajre vajra-garbhe vajraṁ bhavatu mama śarīraṁ:

O Diamond! O Vajragarbha! May my body become a solid and indestructible diamond!

Sarva sattvānāṁ ca kāya pari-viśuddhe:

And may the bodies of all sentient beings be similarly pure!

Sarva gati pariśuddhe:

Throughout all realms, the paths of samsara are pure!

Sarva tathāgatāśca me samāśvāsayantu:

I pray to all the Tathagata to comfort, protect and give me peace!

Sarva tathāgata samāśvāsādhiṣṭhite:

Dwell in the peaceful comfort blessed by all Tathagata!

Budhya budhya, vibudhya vibudhya:

Enlightenment enlightenment, awakening awakening!

Bodhaya bodhaya, vibodhaya vibodhaya:

Enlightenment and enlightenment, allowing all living beings to achieve great enlightenment!

Samanta pariśuddhe:

The entire universe is pure and perfect!

Sarva tathāgata hṛdayādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhita mahāmudre svāhā:

Mahamudra secretly blesses the hearts of all Tathagata, achieving perfect auspiciousness, Ta-ba-ha!

VII. POWER, FUNCTIONS AND SPECIFIC PRACTICES

7.1. The ability to purify the five evils and ten evils, save the three evil paths

• Eliminates all extremely serious sins accumulated over hundreds of thousands of eons: the five transgressions (killing father, killing mother, killing Arhats, disrupting the harmony of monks, causing the Buddha's body to bleed), ten evil sins, defaming Mahayana scriptures, violating the paramita precepts.

• Save sentient beings from the three evil realms: Hell without interruption, hungry and thirsty hungry ghosts, ignorant and dark animals, and the realm of King Yama to punish criminals.

7.2. The Dharma turns disasters into blessings and increases life span

• People with a short fate and many disasters and illnesses, if they are sincere and clean, recite this mantra 21 times or 108 times in front of the Buddha's platform every day, their life will be prolonged, their illnesses will be eliminated, and their blessings will increase immeasurably.

• People who want to be born in the Pure Land: Recite this mantra when they die with a clear and pure mind, and Buddhas and Bodhisattvas will immediately lead them to the Pure Land of Amitābha Buddha.

7.3. Rules for setting up altars and sealing mantras

• Best time: The 8th, 14th or 15th (full moon day) of each month.

7.4. The Dharma of erecting the Ton Thang Sutra pillar (Sutra / Sutra Pillar)

• Wonderful merit:

• Anyone who sees the sutra flag or Ton Thang stupa.

• Whenever anyone passes by, the shadow of the tower or the shadow of the prayer flag covers their body.

7.5. Dharma of spreading sand to bless (Vajra Sa) for super spiritual healing

• If you have a deceased relative who accidentally created many bad karma and fell into hell or dangerous evil paths:

• Spread that sand on the remains or grave of the deceased.
